definitions.explanation: the capacity to understand and grasp information, concepts, or situations

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{理解力|りかいりょく}は{驚|おどろ}くほど{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Children's comprehension ability is surprisingly high.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}が{悪|わる}いせいか、{理解力|りかいりょく}がないせいか{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I don't know if it's bad explanation or lack of comprehension.

examples.japanese: {理解力|りかいりょく}を{高|たか}めるには{読書|どくしょ}が{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: Reading is effective for improving comprehension ability.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{理解|りかい} (understanding) + {力|りょく} (ability/power)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理解力|りかいりょく}がある - to have comprehension ability
- {理解力|りかいりょく}に{欠|か}ける - to lack comprehension ability
- {理解力|りかいりょく}を{高|たか}める - to improve comprehension

USAGE:
- {教育|きょういく} (education) - measuring student comprehension
- {職場|しょくば} (workplace) - understanding instructions/concepts
- コミュニケーション - understanding others

RELATED ～{力|りょく} COMPOUNDS:
- {読解力|どっかいりょく} - reading comprehension
- {聴解力|ちょうかいりょく} - listening comprehension
- {分析力|ぶんせきりょく} - analytical ability
